title: Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture with heavy but pleasant natural reverb, highlighted by a superb entrance into “The Wheel” and a tasty “Sugar Magnolia” segment.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an unusually clean, punch‑forward sound thanks to board‑positioned Sennheiser mics that impart a distinctive, heavenly reverb.  Musically the show is praised for its solid mix, strong vocal blend and standout moments like the opening of “The Wheel” and a memorable “Sugar Magnolia,” making it a highly enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and highlighted both excellent musical performance and high‑quality audio; the weighted average (70 % show, 30 % recording) lands in the strong‑good range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as pristine, clean and crisp with a punchy upfront presence; heavy natural reverb from board mic placement adds character but does not detract from clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing, but reviewers note the mix comes together smoothly and the performance flows well.
